title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil x Mega Man X - Take a Chill Pill! 💊  ~ Tomboyish Girl in Love x Chill Penguin (⑨/⑨ Special Remix)
description:
❝ Just look at you, X... You act so high and mighty... I can't stand it! ❞
ㅤ- Chill Penguin, Mega Man Maverick Hunter X (2006)



Did a special arrangement of Tomboyish Girl in Love x Chill Penguin's Stage from Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil & Mega Man X. I thought it'd be funny to pull another mashup with Icy Penguino's theme for this one 'cuz I felt the need to put him on full blast again.

Initially, this was just gonna be a Chill Penguin remix with bits of Cirno's theme tossed in there, but it became more than that as time went on.

Important:
ㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12)
ㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. E Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. F Minor (Vengeance Pitch)
ㅤ4. D# Minor (Koumakyou Pitch)
ㅤ5. D Minor (MIDIOSYS Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:

ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (VOICE Disabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. Demo Version used for Summer C3 2025 (DEMO Version)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
